using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Orleans.Runtime;
using Xunit;

namespace Orleans.Runtime.Tests
{
    public class InsideRuntimeClientLoggerExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void LogDebug_ReceivedStatusUpdateForUnknownRequest_LogsExpectedMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var messagingOptions = new SiloMessagingOptions { CancelUnknownRequestOnStatusUpdate = false };
            var insideRuntimeClient = CreateInsideRuntimeClientWithLogger(loggerMock.Object, messagingOptions);

            var message = new Message
            {
                Result = Message.ResponseTypes.Status,
                BodyObject = new StatusResponse
                {
                    Diagnostics = new List<string> { "diag1", "diag2" }
                },
                TargetGrain = GrainId.NewId(),
                Id = CorrelationId.NewId(),
                SendingSilo = SiloAddress.NewLocalAddress(0),
                SendingGrain = GrainId.NewId()
            };

            // Setup logger to enable debug level
            loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Debug)).Returns(true);

            // Act
            insideRuntimeClient.InvokeMessageHandler(message);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Debug,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Received status update for unknown request")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        private InsideRuntimeClient CreateInsideRuntimeClientWithLogger(ILogger logger, SiloMessagingOptions messagingOptions)
        {
            var serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
            var loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            loggerFactoryMock.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(typeof(InsideRuntimeClient))).Returns(logger);
            var optionsMock = new Mock<Microsoft.Extensions.Options.IOptions<SiloMessagingOptions>>();
            optionsMock.Setup(o => o.Value).Returns(messagingOptions);

            // We need to provide all required dependencies for InsideRuntimeClient constructor.
            // For simplicity, we provide null or mocks for dependencies not used in this test.

            return new InsideRuntimeClient(
                siloDetails: new LocalSiloDetails(SiloAddress.NewLocalAddress(0), "TestSilo"),
                serviceProvider: serviceProviderMock.Object,
                messageFactory: new MessageFactory(),
                loggerFactory: loggerFactoryMock.Object,
                messagingOptions: optionsMock.Object,
                messagingTrace: null,
                referenceActivator: null,
                interfaceIdResolver: null,
                interfaceToTypeResolver: null,
                deepCopier: null,
                timeProvider: TimeProvider.Default,
                interfaceToImplementationMapping: null);
        }
    }

    // Minimal stubs for required types
    internal class LocalSiloDetails : ILocalSiloDetails
    {
        public LocalSiloDetails(SiloAddress siloAddress, string name)
        {
            SiloAddress = siloAddress;
            Name = name;
        }
        public SiloAddress SiloAddress { get; }
        public string Name { get; }
    }

    internal class MessageFactory
    {
        public Message CreateMessage(IInvokable request, InvokeMethodOptions options) => new Message();
    }

    internal class Message
    {
        public enum ResponseTypes { Status, Other }
        public ResponseTypes Result { get; set; }
        public object BodyObject { get; set; }
        public GrainId TargetGrain { get; set; }
        public CorrelationId Id { get; set; }
        public SiloAddress SendingSilo { get; set; }
        public GrainId SendingGrain { get; set; }
    }

    internal class StatusResponse
    {
        public List<string> Diagnostics { get; set; }
    }

    internal class GrainId
    {
        public static GrainId NewId() => new GrainId();
    }

    internal class CorrelationId
    {
        public static CorrelationId NewId() => new CorrelationId();
    }

    internal class SiloAddress
    {
        public static SiloAddress NewLocalAddress(int gen) => new SiloAddress();
    }

    internal interface ILocalSiloDetails
    {
        SiloAddress SiloAddress { get; }
        string Name { get; }
    }

    internal interface IInvokable { }

    internal enum InvokeMethodOptions { None = 0 }

    internal class TimeProvider
    {
        public static TimeProvider Default { get; } = new TimeProvider();
    }
}
